tasks.title: Evaluate listing the Policy Gate Kit on Whop (second marketplace)
tasks.description: Whop listing would be a second live shelf for the kit. Their marketplace operates under platform terms including a revenue share on each sale. Decide whether Nightshift may enter this distribution arrangement.
journal: 2026-08-15 12:13 — question asked: May Nightshift list the Policy Gate Kit on Whop's marketplace under Whop's standard terms, which take a percentage revenue share on each sale? This is a new distribution agreement with a third-party platform, not a routine sale.
